MALLET 0.23.0 preview - Mapping And Level Layout Editor Tool: a map editor for SurfsUp (and Counter-Strike: Source)
===================================================================================================================

START HERE
- Unzip the whole folder somewhere (keep MALLET.exe, MALLET.pck and the "materials" folder together) and
  double-click MALLET.exe. Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" (the program isn't signed): click
  "More info", then "Run anyway".
- The guide: docs\GUIDE.html (or Help > The MALLET guide inside MALLET, or "New here? Read the guide" on the
  welcome screen). It takes you from an empty map to one your friends can play in ten minutes, then covers
  everything else: ramps, zones, build mode, materials, playing, testing with others and exporting.
- Everything new, version by version: docs\CHANGELOG.html (Help > What's new).

NEW IN 0.23.0
- Material maker > Finish: brightness and light of its own with no limit, glossiness and reflectiveness up to a
  mirror. Gamma in Adjust colors. Map panel > Reflections of the map.
- Textures can spin and swirl (ramp texture settings, F3 in build mode).
- Every pool of water, lava or glass can have its own look (build mode T menu > Fill > Their look).

NEW IN 0.22.0
- The guide (docs\GUIDE.html), a Help menu, and a fifth template: Cube Park, built in build mode, with a teleport
  that keeps your speed.
- Fixed: the Geometry menu's triangular prism ignored its Length.

NEW IN 0.21.0
- Make your own materials or change existing ones: material picker > Make / edit a material (or right-click a
  material). "+ Ridge line" puts a line along a ramp's ridge. Your materials travel inside the maps that use them.

WHAT WE'D LOVE YOU TO TEST
- Follow the guide's "A first map in ten minutes" from a blank map. Where did you get stuck?
- Make a material with the material maker and use it on a ramp, then export the map to SurfsUp and CS:S.
- Co-edit with a friend (guide section 8) and send a friend a test build.
- Anything that breaks, looks wrong or is confusing: tell whoever sent you MALLET what you did, what you expected
  and what happened.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Save with Ctrl+S; maps are .mallet files. Older SurfForge .sfmap maps still open.
- Export > To SurfsUp needs SurfsUp installed; Export > To Counter-Strike: Source needs CS:S installed.
- F1 in build mode shows every key on screen.
